¿Cuánto crees que llevas aquí?: How long do you think you've been here?
Escúchame bien, porque no te lo voy a re: Listen carefully, because I won't say it twice. Time here **doesn't run the same** as where you were born.

Take me to whoever's in charge.
Yo te conocí de pequeña. Siempre pegada: I knew you when you were little. Always stuck to your mother, in the square.
Llevo veinte años oyendo lo que dicen de: For twenty years I've heard what they say about you. And it never matched that girl.
¿Y por eso me sueltas?: And that's why you're untying me?
Te suelto porque bajaste de una nave pud: I'm untying you because you came down off a ship when you didn't have to.
